messages:
Maya (Billing): Heads up — ACME corp (PO #PO-9981) reported their mid-cycle downgrade didn't receive the prorated credit on invoice inv_2026_9981. They were downgraded on 2026-11-03 UTC. Invoice shows full-month charge.
Jason (Support): @Maya logged ticket #TKT-12345, customer pasted invoice PDF. Says card didn't decline; they require PO matching on invoices so we couldn't auto-apply promo credit. :confused:
Maya (Billing): Right — looks like our PO check prevented automatic mid-cycle credit flow. Our proration job returned a rounding diff and flagged as needs_manual_review. Snippet from job log:
```
prorate_calc: expected_credit=47.97
applied_credit=0.00
reason=po_mismatch_skip
rounding_delta=0.03
```
Sofia (Eng): Can you paste the invoice line items? I want to confirm sequence lengths used in the proration calc.
Maya (Billing): inv_2026_9981 lines:
- old_plan: 120.00 (billing_period 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30)
- new_plan: 80.00 (downgrade effective 2026-11-03)
prorated_credit_calc = (120-80) * (27/30) = 40 * 0.9 = 36.00 -> but promo credit pro-rated + rounding -> expected credit 47.97 (customer has promo carryover)
Kevin (Finance): Hmm the math looks off — sounds like promo carryover added separately. If automatic flow skipped, we need to create a credit note and link to PO so AP can approve. Approving manual credit of 47.97 EUR. @Arin can you confirm payment rails and ledger entries?
Arin (Payments): Got it. I checked charges: last_charge_id=ch_3KXY... settled. We can issue credit note CN-2026-551 but need finance approval and PO attestation. I'll reserve a negative line of 47.97 and flag for ledger sync. ETA: 2 business days.
billing-bot: Automated alert — proration_job failed on inv_2026_9981 with code 422_PO_MISMATCH at 2026-11-03T14:22:10Z. Link: https://invoices.redwood.internal/ops/alerts/422_PO_MISMATCH
Jason (Support): Customer needs ETA and confirmation that PO will be included on the credit note for their accounts payable team. Can we have a manual process checklist? :thumbsup:
Maya (Billing): Recommended process (we followed partially):
1) Confirm PO matches customer profile -> YES (PO-9981)
2) Re-run proration engine with override allow_po=true
3) If re-run still fails, create CN with manual line + note referencing TKT-12345 and PO-9981
4) Send for Kevin sign-off -> Kevin to reply with 'approve' in thread
If approved I'll attach CN to inv_2026_9981 and mark as applied.
Kevin (Finance): approve (confirming approval of CN-2026-551 for 47.97 EUR; include PO-9981 and note: 'mid-cycle downgrade manual proration, customer requested PO on credit')
Maya (Billing): Thanks. @Arin please create CN and set ledger_tag=manual-proration. I'll notify customer and attach proof. Jason, can you update TKT-12345 with expected 2 business days? 
Jason (Support): On it. Adding note to ticket and emailing AP contact. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Sofia (Eng): Follow-up: I'll add a small metric to the proration job to surface po_mismatch_skip counts so we can alert earlier. Created ENG-PR-678. Will loop you in.
Kevin (Finance): small ask: include the exact rounding delta in the CN metadata so accounting can reconcile.
Maya (Billing): Will do. end.
